{"dialogue": "Devon: finally home, kitchen still smells like smoke lol
Me: oh no what happened
Devon: tried to do homemade dough tonight
Devon: thought i could do better than takeout
Me: and?
Devon: burned the bottom straight to black
Me: nooo not the homemade era
Devon: fr, set the oven too high like an idiot
Me: what temp did you do?
Devon: like 500, recipe said hot but damn
Me: yeah that'll do it
Devon: crust went from pale to charcoal in like two mins
Me: did you at least get a pic before it died
Devon: nah was too busy opening windows
Devon: cat is still mad at me for the smoke alarm
Me: lol poor girl, mine would've run under the bed
Devon: she did, then came back screaming for treats like nothing happened
Me: classic, so is dinner ruined?
Devon: kinda, top was actually okay but bottom tastes like campfire
Me: just scrape it? my mom used to do that with toast
Devon: tried, still bitter
Devon: ended up just doing toast again
Me: back to the toast era
Devon: peanut butter saves the day once more
Me: elite fallback honestly
Devon: how was your day tho
Me: long, 5th was still backed up by the bank
Devon: ugh still? those cones are permanent at this point
Me: for real, i should've just taken oak
Devon: i cut through by the office and it wasn't better
Me: cat was already on my clean laundry when i walked in
Devon: of course, tradition
Me: literally only the clean load
Devon: zero chill as usual
Devon: oh mom asked about you this morning
Me: aww tell her i said hi
Devon: she said she has leftover potato salad if you want some
Me: oh tell her i love her, i might stop by tomorrow after noon?
Devon: she'll hold you to that lol
Me: i have no self control with that stuff
Devon: same as us with garlic knots
Me: did yours even survive the drive home back then
Devon: absolutely not, ate em in the car
Me: same
Devon: anyway i'm airing out the kitchen and calling the dough experiment a fail
Me: hey at least you tried, my dough would've been worse
Devon: next time i'm setting a timer and actually watching it
Me: and maybe not 500 lol
Devon: lesson learned, low and slow-ish
Me: you gonna try again this week?
Devon: maybe, still have flour everywhere to clean up first
Me: lol good luck with that
Devon: gonna need it, smoke smell is in my sweatshirt now
Me: febreze and toast, perfect sunday night
Devon: pretty much, you doing laundry tonight?
Me: nah tomorrow, still have clean socks for once
Devon: wow growth
Me: lol adulting win", "writer_note": "Kept the evening window and established voices with callbacks to traffic, cats on clean laundry, toast era, and mom's potato salad, letting the burned homemade dough land early with light teasing and no new restaurant plan."}
